utterances.speaker: speaker_2

utterances.speaker: speaker_2

utterances.speaker: speaker_1

utterances.speaker: speaker_2

utterances.speaker: speaker_2

utterances.speaker: speaker_1

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: we can fit forty seats on the team plan before you would need to upgrade tiers

utterances.speaker: speaker_2

utterances.speaker: speaker_2
utterances.text: forty came up again near the end of the call but i honestly could not tell you what it was about anymore
